verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official open-source CLI (github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli). It installs via curl or brew and uses browser OAuth or client-credentials agent login. It is built for agents: `--agent` JSON output, `--no-input` for CI, and profile switching. It covers 12 resources (bills, cards, funds, transactions, reimbursements, travel and more), defaults to the sandbox, and includes packaged agent skills such as agentic-purchase. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI actually running (the probe only confirms the repo is documented).
